chunks: But they will surely not wish for death because of what they had done in the past; and God knows the sinners well.
ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers not wish for death according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific reluctance of the Jews of Medina to embrace Islam, as they feared death would end their opportunity for further accumulation of wealth and status. It underscores the psychological barrier of worldly attachment that prevents sincere acceptance of divine truth, while affirming Allah's precise knowledge of the unjust.
